name: Chatot
description: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

moves.name: Gust
moves.description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Air Cutter
moves.description: The user launches razor-like wind to slash the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Roost
moves.description: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky.

moves.name: Mimic
moves.description: The user copies the target's last move. The move can be used during battle until the Pokémon is switched out.

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts, raising the user's offensive stats.

moves.name: Play Rough
moves.description: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target’s offensive stats.

moves.name: Hurricane
moves.description: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind.
